entries.7a0722c6c7b49a54: Its strength lies in having two businesses: food products and chemical products. In chemical products, it has a long track record of manufacturing enzymes and raw materials for pharmaceutical and food uses, such as dextran, whose production began in 1954, and rennet, whose production began in 1967, and its enzymes are sold mainly in overseas markets. In food products, it combines its own-brand products, such as 'Alphabet Chocolate,' with contract manufacturing, and through a company it made a subsidiary, has expanded its product range into Baumkuchen, jelly and imogashi.
